about: Standard API prices, USD per million tokens, for the models `roundtrip_eval.py --cost` prices a run of: no batch discount, no prompt cache, no priority tier, prompts under 200k tokens. Read from each vendor's own pricing page on the date given; prices move, so confirm them before spending anything. The Anthropic rows were read from the page's table directly; the OpenAI and Google rows through a summary of their pages, and are the ones to check first.
tokenizer_note: Anthropic's page says Claude 4.7 and later use a tokenizer that produces about 30% more tokens for the same text; --cost counts tokens from characters and applies that factor to those models.

models.note: the page gives this price through 2026-12-31 and $1.50 / $7.50 from 2027-01-01; it also lists a free tier
